articles.title: Affiliate Has Outgrown the Bottom of the Funnel
articles.summary: Affiliate marketing is undergoing four major shifts: it must influence customers before they are ready to buy, trust matters more than traffic alone, creator and affiliate strategies need to operate as one partnership strategy, and measurement must extend beyond last click. Brands should expand partner programs beyond coupon and cashback sites to include publishers, comparison sites, reviewers, and creators that shape discovery and consideration. They also need broader measurement and shared data to value influence across the full customer journey. These changes position affiliate as a growth strategy that helps create demand, not just capture existing demand.

articles.title: Amid growing AI distrust, humanity takes a front seat in advertising
articles.summary: The growing backlash against AI is prompting brands to make humanity itself a central theme in advertising, either through explicit messaging or more tactile, imperfect creative. Tech brands such as Anthropic and Meta are using optimistic narratives to address concerns about AI, while brands such as Polaroid, Pinterest, and Heineken are encouraging consumers to reconnect with the physical world. Brands can reinforce this positioning through film, handmade aesthetics, natural elements, and behind-the-scenes content that shows real people creating the work. The strategy works best when humanity reflects a genuine point of view rather than becoming another empty brand buzzword.

articles.title: Turn sitemaps into SEO intel
articles.summary: Competitor XML sitemaps can act as a weekly SEO change log. Save a snapshot of a competitor's sitemap, then compare it each week to spot new pages, removals, and emerging content clusters. This tactic can reveal what competitors are building before those changes show up in rankings. A Google Sheet tracker and Apps Script is provided in the comment thread.

articles.title: 4 funnel fixes
articles.summary: A creator with 10K email subscribers and a paid community had a solid foundation, but an audit uncovered 4 ways to grow revenue. First, fix leaks in the opt-in flow with a thank-you page and by removing double opt-in. Then, encourage monthly members to switch to annual plans for more upfront revenue and stronger retention. From there, build evergreen onboarding and cancellation sequences, and add monthly promotions to drive more signups without relying solely on regular emails.

articles.title: YouTube AEO Guide: How to Dominate AI Search with YouTube
articles.summary: YouTube now draws roughly 200x more AI citations than any other platform, and its share of social citations 4x in four months to overtake Reddit as the top-cited social source in Q1 2026. Automatic transcripts are the core driver, turning every explainer video into a searchable text document AI models can parse directly instead of relying on tags or descriptions alone. That citation strength concentrates almost entirely in long-form video, since AI models weight depth and comprehensive topic coverage that Shorts aren't built to carry.

articles.title: Try Google Pics: Easy image creation and editing in Google Workspace
articles.summary: Google Pics is an AI image creation and editing tool powered by Google's Nano Banana model. It can generate graphics, edit specific objects, and change text within images. It also creates multiple versions from one prompt. Pics is rolling out to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers and most Workspace business customers. It will also integrate with Docs, Slides, and Drive.

articles.title: How to Find and Pitch Real Case Studies for Digital PR with Becca Peel
articles.summary: Case studies are becoming a critical part of digital PR because journalists need real people who can make data credible, relevant, and harder to replicate with AI. PR teams should start with their own networks, then verify each person through signals such as LinkedIn, business listings, websites, and direct calls before pitching. Strong case studies offer a genuinely new insight, connect directly to the campaign data, and give journalists an exclusive human angle they cannot simply find through Google.

articles.title: How E.l.f. Beauty is building AI into its community management
articles.summary: E.l.f. Beauty's AI reply tool, E.l.f.luencer, is trained on the brand's own stylebook and years of past community-manager responses to answer social comments automatically, with every reply still reviewed by a human before it posts. The tool now generates 90% of the brand's TikTok and Instagram replies in E.l.f.'s specific tone, language, and emoji use, pushing the response rate from 30-40% before launch to more than 80% now. That volume would be impossible for a manual team to match, and the same AI investment underpins a broader program of 85 agentic pilots the company is moving toward full production.
